name: BUSI-WHU: Breast Cancer Ultrasound Image Dataset
description: BUSI-WHU is a breast cancer ultrasound imaging dataset collected from female patients aged 17 to 79 at the Department of Ultrasound, Renmin Hospital of Wuhan University (WHU). Hosted on Mendeley Data, the dataset contains 927 B-mode breast ultrasound images across benign and malignant breast tumors. The images illustrate diverse tumor morphology, margins, acoustic shadowing, and echogenicity characteristics, designed for evaluating computer-aided diagnosis, classification, and lesion segmentation models in clinical breast ultrasound.
